materials.base: oiled timber with bolted metal shoes
materials.frame: forged dark iron and aged steel
materials.mechanisms: machined brass gears, collars, pulleys, and fasteners
materials.pressure_system: aged copper pipework and enamel-faced gauges
materials.winch: layered rough rope wound on a metal drum

prohibited_changes: do not change construction stage requirements, work duration, citizen assignments, or project site
do not change the gameplay-owned deployment cable, anchor, physics, or SurfaceNavigation connection
do not add generated render geometry to collision, navigation, selection, or traversal calculations
do not change RoomDefinition, construction destinations, or target-surface identity
do not fall back to an unregistered procedural grapple after an accepted asset fails to load
required_features: readable winch drum, rope winding, and meshing exposed gears
distinct structural base, winch, and launcher stage groups
braced vertical launcher with rung or ladder cues and a top pulley
small functional-looking pressure plumbing, controls, fasteners, and joints
materials remain distinguishable at citizen and close inspection distances
production-scale bounds fit the established construction footprint
visual_target: A believable hand-built miniature steampunk grappling installation: a planted timber and forged-iron base, exposed rope winch and readable gear train, copper pressure plumbing and controls, and a braced launcher tower with a top pulley. Materials must read as distinct wood, dark iron, brass, copper, and rope under the actual RoomScale room lighting. Preserve the existing construction-stage reveal and leave cable deployment to gameplay.
